actual: Many BUG fixes run broad module suites and repeated UI/backend validation per issue, even when the tests are not real business-flow evidence and can be deferred to nightly.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Many BUG fixes run broad module suites and repeated UI/backend validation per issue, even when the tests are not real business-flow evidence and can be deferred to nightly. Also, workflow policy should avoid inferring UI visual validation from generic words such as issue workflow. Added scope also covers compact resume digests, exploration budgets, and diagnostic-only JSON artifacts on successful workflow/validation paths.
expected: Most BUG fixes use risk-based lightweight PR validation; high-risk fixes keep only safety/contract gates before merge; nightly aggregates all daily BUG changes and runs deduplicated deep business-flow validation. Codex and Claude Code instructions should follow the same policy. Successful paths should avoid unused diagnostic JSON output; restarted Codex/Claude windows should use resume/task-card digests instead of repeatedly reading standards and source ranges.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: Review BUG-580 / PR #1837 validation evidence: deletion of obsolete surface ran paper_v2_backend and validation_center_backend plus many local tests.
